notes.title: $300 AI quick match prize!
notes.content:
We have now raised the AI quick match prize to $300 we appreciate everyone who supports the game. To all the naysayers, just know that Parts Unknown is an independent online MMO that currently has no outside funding. Parts Unknown is the first game to push ReadyPlayerMe technology to the limit. Our goal is to give players the freedom to upload their own clothing and animations dynamically. This is not an easy task we are in the pursuit of revolutionizing online character creation. 


-Parts Unknown Productions Team

notes.title: AI Quickmatch! 250$ Grand Prize
notes.content: We now have AI quick matches. First fighter to 100 wins will receive 250$

notes.title: Quick Match prize is now 200$
notes.content: We appreciate everyone for supporting the game. We have raised the quick match prize to 200$ to show our appreciation.

notes.title: PlayStation and Xbox compatible!
notes.content: You can now use your PlayStation and Xbox controller we want to thank everyone for their support

notes.title: 100 dollar grand prize for quick match
notes.content: We appreciate all of our "unknowners" for continuing to play the game. We will have grand prizes weekly to show our appreciation. First fighter to 50 wins in quick match will receive 100 dollars via Paypal from Parts Unknown Productions.

notes.title: Play Parts Unknown 2024 for updates
notes.content: We are no longer updating Parts Unknown all updates are being pushed to Parts Unknown 2024. We have removed the leaderboard and online usernames and will eventually shut down the server.

notes.title: Final Update for 2023
notes.content: This will be the last update of the year we want to thank everyone for their support we have a lot of special surprises for 2024. Parts Unknown will be around for a very long time we are establishing the proper relationships to create longevity.

notes.title: Leaderboard and rep update
notes.content: Special cash prizes will be rewarded for the top 10 players on the leaderboard.

notes.title: Leaderboard!
notes.content: Leaderboard is now available there will be special prizes available for top ranked players we have events coming up soon we have been working with music artists and fighters to generate exclusive music and content for the game.

notes.title: Parts Unknown location update
notes.content: We noticed there was a slight lag at the Parts Unknown location. We have removed a few things from the location to decrease the lag issue. We are working hard to create a great experience for everyone.

notes.title: Rep coin system update
notes.content:
Your rep is now tied to your Steam account! We have been working overtime to ensure that your data is saved no matter the device you have! We are now ready to expand rapidly. We noticed few bad reviews concerning the ReadyPlayerMe website. We want to ensure everyone that ReadyPlayerMe is a legit platform I will leave a link to the ReadyPlayerME about page below. Please remember that we are trying to create the Metaverse and that will consist of us integrating with platforms regularly. We want to thank everyone for their support!


ReadyPlayerMe about page - https://readyplayer.me/company/about-us

notes.title: Upgrade store is complete!
notes.content: We are happy to announce that the upgrade store is complete. We will continue to make improvements. All of your data is being moved to the cloud for security reasons. We worked hard to establish a secure connection with PlayFab and Steam so you can keep all of your upgrades no matter the device you use. If you have any issues please feel free to reach out to us. We want to ensure everyone has a great experience moving forward. We are about to scale the game very rapidly so stay tuned for more updates. We want to thank everyone for their support.

notes.title: Integration with PlayFab
notes.content: We want to apologize to the users who have experienced any issues with PlayFab. We are currently working with them to establish our own network. This needs to be accomplished to ensure your upgrades are tied to your cloud account and not your local device. This will guarantee that your upgrades are secure and accurate regardless of the device you are using. We have removed the upgrade store for now until we complete the integration. We want to thank everyone for their patience and support. We will update everyone when the store is functional again.

notes.title: Jeet Kune Do!
notes.content: Jeet Kune Do fighting style available for purchase in the upgrade store! We worked with a professional fighter to make this fighting style. Please support the game by purchasing this fighting style. We need your help to continue to make the game!

notes.title: Tackling update
notes.content: Each fighting style has a unique tackling animation. While running press "Q" to tackle opponents. Use the focus feature to make tackling easier. We have a new fighting style coming soon "Jeet Kune Do" all the animation will be done by professionals.

notes.title: Fighting style update!
notes.content: All fighting styles have been updated you will notice each fighting style has a unique set of animations. We have began to work with dancers to incorporate dancing animations mix with fighting animations. Our goal is to add every fighting style that exists to the game. We need your support please purchase rep coins so we can continue to add authentic animations to the game.

notes.title: Updated UI
notes.content: Updated the UI. Earn rep to increase your run stamina and jump height!

notes.title: Freeflow Combat
notes.content: We have been working on the combat system we plan to work with professional fighters to create authentic fighting animations. We need your support to continue working on the game. Please purchase rep coins to keep the game going!

notes.title: Grapple Update
notes.content: We noticed an issue with the grapple move while using Windows PC. The issue has been addressed in this update. We want to thank everyone for their patience.

notes.title: Server Updates
notes.content: We noticed a few issues with the online server that we have addressed in this new update. Please support the game by purchasing Rep coins and upgrading your character. In order for the game to continue we need the support of the community we will continue to push as many updates as we can to make the game an enjoyable experience for everyone.

notes.title: Unknown Mountains!
notes.content: New location available 100,000 rep or more needed to enter the location. Earn rep by training in the gym and fighting at locations. Sprint stamina and jump ability will increase as your rep increases. We made a lot of updates to the fighting we have a new fighting style coming soon we are working to get authenic animations performed by professional fighters.

notes.title: Jump Attacks!
notes.content: Jump attacks have been improved we are excited to incorporate fighting styles with open world parkour animations we want to thank everyone for their patience we have made a lot of changes to the game to make the experience better for everyone we really want to build a unique online community we are currently working with professional fighters to create authentic fighting animations.

notes.title: Trick Jumps
notes.content: Each fighting style has a trick jump. Jump from high and punish enemies by performing a trick jump. Halloween event will be available this weekend.

notes.title: Major update
notes.content: Revamped the fighting Halloween event coming soon.

notes.title: Weapons are no longer available
notes.content: Due to the male and female ReadyPlayerME avatars being slightly different we can no longer support weapons. We will continue to make the fighting styles better and possibly incorporate weapons in the future. We appreciate everyone's support and we will have another online event soon.

notes.title: Updated fighting styles
notes.content: Each fighting style has a unique takedown and streak animations. Workout in the gym to earn more rep to increase your run/sprint speed! Leaderboards will be available soon!

notes.title: New fighting style available!
notes.content: New fighting style available build up your rep while using cool dance moves!

notes.title: Unknown Gym!
notes.content: Unknown Gym is now available work out to earn more rep! More fighting styles and upgrades coming soon.

notes.title: Big Update!
notes.content: The online map has just gotten bigger! NPC's have been upgraded with more random animations. New Locations and fighting styles will be available soon. Feel free to reach out to us if you have any questions.

notes.title: Hit streaks!
notes.content: Hit streaks are now incorporated in the game. If you get several hits in a row without getting hit you will unlock new moves while on hit streak. Each fighting style has different moves when on hit streak! The payment system for upgrades is now in production if you have any issues making purchases please reach out to partsunknown2023@gmail.com for assistance. We have more events coming up for Halloween we appreciate everyone's support!

notes.title: Unknown Beach available!
notes.content: Unknown Beach is available as well as upgrades. We will have another event in the next few weeks. More fighting styles will be available soon.

notes.title: Online Event has started special guest Dontell Pickett
notes.content:
Special guest Dontell Pickett is releasing new music from his new album Gorilla Tactics exclusively on Parts Unknown the event will be going on for 7 days and we will be adding new content each day. Story mode is no longer available on the game we will focus on online mode and the online events moving forward. Unknown beach will be available in the next few days. You can select your fighting style in online mode now more fighting styles will be available soon. 

Dontell Pickett's Spotify link:
https://open.spotify.com/artist/6T7kZs4B2QfzCiMOBbriCn

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content: Online has been updated the fighting is so much more fluid now we have the online event coming up on Saturday 9/23/2023 we have more fighting styles that will be available online soon as well as new locations to fight. ReadyPlayerMe has updated their software you can now customize your shoes, shirt, and pants individually and also create your own clothing via blender! We have more updates coming every week we appreciate everyone's support!

notes.title: Online event this Saturday 9/23/2023
notes.content: Special guest Donnell Picket will be performing unreleased music in online mode. New free flow fighting has been added to online mode along with a new grapple feature to takedown enemies.  Unknown Beach and other updates coming soon.

notes.title: Online Revamp
notes.content: Revamped the fighting online more updates coming soon.

notes.title: Online Update
notes.content: Added more moves to the online fighting we are working with artists to add more fighting styles, artwork, and music to the game. Unknown Beach will be available soon.

notes.title: Fight Update
notes.content: We are currently only focused on online mode. Use the focus feature to attack enemies when online. We have new furniture and artwork coming for the apartment so be sure to rack up the Rep points online. We want to thank everyone for supporting this independent project!

notes.title: Online Brawl!
notes.content: We have added NPC's to online mode we have also added a "Rep" counter to track how many hits you get when playing online. You can trade in your rep points for special prizes and for new furniture in your apartment. More updates will be coming soon we are working on a 1v1 competitive play online mode as well.

notes.title: Major Online Update!
notes.content: Brand new power ups and obstacles online! We will continue to update the apartment more updates coming soon! 50$ grand prizes are still available online. We appreciate everyones support!

notes.title: Apartment!!!
notes.content: Customize your apartment before playing online! The next update will have different fighting styles and power ups you can use online!

notes.title: Updated Art
notes.content: Updated Art Gallery. More updates coming soon.

notes.title: First Event!!
notes.content: We are throwing our first official event. New exclusive music available for a limited time. Come and join the party!

notes.title: Basketball!
notes.content: We corrected all errors with online mode. We are finally ready to expand! Fashion show grand prize is still applicable so submit your pictures as soon as possible. Weapon upgrades and animation upgrades will be coming soon. Shoot around at the new basketball court online!

notes.title: 50$ cash prize for best outfit online
notes.content: Updated online mode once again. Please send your best outfit to the email provided in the game when on the runway and have a chance at winning the cash prize. More events and updates coming soon.

notes.title: Online Update!
notes.content:
New events will be added online frequently! Explore around and see what's new! Cash prize for best outfit on the runway take a screenshot of your outfit and send to partsunknown2023@gmail.com

Other updates made:

1. Fixed camera in story mode

2. Expanded map in online mode

3. Real animations coming soon via deep motion

notes.title: Online Event
notes.content: In this update we fixed a few things with the online environment. Next update we will be announcing all of the details for the online event. Cash prizes will be given out to the faithful supporters who continue to believe in the game.

notes.title: Online Metaverse
notes.content:
You can create your own avatar for story mode and online now! We are one of the first games to accomplish this and we are very excited to announce the first Parts Unknown online event on 5/20/2023
We will be sharing more details soon. We also expanded the map and fixed the vehicle mechanics for online mode!

notes.title: Story mode update
notes.content: There was an issue with the NPC's in story mode this has now been fixed we are still working on a way to integrate ReadyPlayerMe into online. The event coming up will have a cash prize along with a championship belt and Nacho Libre mask. I want to thank everyone for playing the game let's continue to build the online community.

notes.title: Upcoming Online Event!
notes.content: Mac Vs Windows event coming soon! Winner will receive a Nacho Libre mask and a cash prize. The amount has not been decided yet. Also we have a new focus feature in online mode where you can focus the camera on all of the enemies online. This will make it easier to fight while online. Next Patch you will be able create your online player within the game without going to the ReadyPlayerMe website.

notes.title: Story Mode Patch
notes.content: Fixed the fighting in story mode. Im dedicated to making this game the best ever for you all. Thanks so much for the support.

notes.title: Online Revamp
notes.content:
Improved online combat (more hit animations and camera shake on successful punch)

Improved online map and sound

notes.title: Map Update
notes.content: The online map just got bigger! we will continue to update online multiplayer.

notes.title: Online Car mechanics
notes.content: Car controls are smoother and vary between car. Online quick match coming soon for competitive play. We will work on getting the game ready for Playstation and Xbox now that the game server is active.

notes.title: Online Map update (cars)
notes.content: The online map is much bigger now we have also added cars so you can drive around the map. The map will continue to get larger

notes.title: Online Patch
notes.content: If you experience issues joining a room please restart the game. You can fight anyone who joins the room or team up with them its up to you! Weapon upgrades will be available soon and character creation for online is coming soon also.

notes.title: Online mode
notes.content: Online mode is finally available we will continue to add more features to the online gameplay daily.

notes.title: Fight update
notes.content: Fighting mechanics are being patched everyday for a better experience please let us know if you have any problems we will be sure to correct it right away please keep in mind that we are building this game for the long term and it will eventually be more than just a fighting game and fully integrated with the Metaverse.

notes.title: New Side Mission/ Fight update
notes.content: There is a new side mission on the main menu we have also patched fighting once again to make the game more enjoyable. Unknown beach will be available soon along with online play.

notes.title: Big Patch Update
notes.content: Bugs in the fighting should be updated we will continue to patch fighting.

notes.title: Side Mission Update
notes.content: There is now a side mission available on the main menu. The fighting was also patched again as well for better performance. Online mode is still being developed and should be available soon.

notes.title: UI and AI update
notes.content: The run punch and run kick have been patched along with some improvements to the UI. Online quick match coming soon.

notes.title: Updated fighting
notes.content: Continuing to improve the fighting daily
